text: Oneirology [Gr. oneiroV , dream, + logoV , science]: Ger. Oneirologie ; Fr. (1) onirologie , (2) oniromancie ; Ital. onirologia . (1) The science of DREAMS (q.v.) and (2) of their interpretation. Cf. SLEEP (also for literature). Oneiromancy is a better term for (2). ( J.M.B. - G.F.S. )
